The '''5th Lon Flotilla''' was a naval formation of the [[Freda system militias]]. It participated in [[Battle of the Rettna system|attack]] against [[Jante]] holdings in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Along with the 3rd, the 5th was chased and engaged by the [[Rett II orbital defense force]] until the 1st Flotilla was able to offer assistance.
